columns.name: distance_view_distance_bucket
columns.comment: Grouping of user distance from location extensions.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpc
columns.comment: The total cost of all clicks divided by the total number of clicks received.

columns.name: metrics_conversions
columns.comment: The number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_from_interactions_rate
columns.comment: Conversions from interactions divided by the number of ad interactions (such as clicks for text ads or views for video ads). This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cost_micros
columns.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period.

columns.name: metrics_cost_per_conversion
columns.comment: The cost of ad interactions divided by conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_ctr
columns.comment: The number of clicks your ad receives (Clicks) divided by the number of times your ad is shown (Impressions).

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: metrics_view_through_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of view-through conversions. These happen when a customer sees an image or rich media ad, then later completes a conversion on your site without interacting with (e.g., clicking on) another ad.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of the week, e.g., MONDAY.

columns.name: segments_month
columns.comment: Month as represented by the date of the first day of a month. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_quarter
columns.comment: Quarter as represented by the date of the first day of a quarter. Uses the calendar year for quarters, e.g., the second quarter of 2018 starts on 2018-04-01. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_week
columns.comment: Week as defined as Monday through Sunday, and represented by the date of Monday. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
